subject: [PATCH v5 7/7] mm: use VMA flag helpers in NUMA balancing

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Identified that the 'Acked-by' tag is no longer required, suggesting it be removed. Also mentioned that the patch LGTM and that there might be trivial conflicts with his own VMA flags series.

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged Lorenzo's comment about the 'Acked-by' tag and agreed to remove it. Also mentioned that he cargo-culted the tag from prior revisions.

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch series introduces VMA flag helpers to improve the NUMA balancing code in the kernel. The changes aim to simplify and standardize the use of VM flags, reducing the risk of errors and making the code more maintainable.
